simple.meaning: מִלְחָמָה (milchâmâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a battle (i.e. the engagement ); generally, war (i.e. war-fare ).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 319 times in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 14:2. The surrounding contexts include kingship, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִלְחָמָה (H4421) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מִלְחָמָה (milchâmâh) / H4421 is traced through Genesis 14:2, Genesis 14:8, Exodus 1:10, Exodus 13:17 with source-language evidence and verse context.
